about: The graduale of the formulary “Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: You are sorrowful and tearful, O Virgin Mary, standing beside the Cross of your Son, the Lord Jesus, the Redeemer. O Virgin Mother of God, the One whom all the world does not contain, the author of life become man, bears this torment of the Cross.

a.g: the whole world does not contain
